title: BC Friday Tips #60 DevToys
summary: DevToys is a free collection of utilities that support Business Central development tasks like encoding, code formatting, regex testing, and data conversion. It helps developers work more efficiently.
key_points: DevToys offers free tools specifically useful for BC development workflows
Includes base64 encoding/decoding, QR code handling, regex testing, and JSON/XML formatting
Provides date conversion and text/list comparison capabilities
Can speed up development processes through these integrated utilities

quotes.text: DevToys is a collection of free tools that can help you with your Business Central development.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes that DevToys is a free resource specifically relevant to BC developers
Highlights the key benefit of using these tools to improve development productivity
